title: TaskContext
description: v1 — airlock → oracle at spawn. Tells the agent what wake it is running, and its budget. The tool catalog is delivered separately as the model's tool definitions.

source.description: The single source this wake handles.

goal.description: Human-readable objective, e.g. 'Assemble this source's leading indicators for the M3 new-orders nowcast; abstain if incomplete.'

model.description: OpenRouter model id for this job, e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'. Gated by the airlock's [models] allowlist.

series.description: Series IDs the oracle is allowed to fetch for this source.
